    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Decision to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S03</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" name="Organize accommodation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S05</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Join" name="Setup completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_DetermineCompetentRepresentation" name="Determine competent representation office">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D12" sourceRef="Task_CheckPassportValidity" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D13" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D14" sourceRef="Task_ObtainTravelHealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D15" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D16" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D17" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Submission_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="Gateway_Submission_Merge" targetRef="Task_SubmitVisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Task_SubmitVisaApplication" targetRef="Event_VisaDecisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Event_VisaDecisionReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_X01" name="Granted" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Event_RenewalDue">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R01" sourceRef="Event_RenewalDue" targetRef="Task_RenewVisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R03" sourceRef="Task_RenewVisaApplication" targetRef="Gateway_Submission_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
